Home.metaDescription: Find providers and organizations on Bookie, then reserve a time that works.
Home.overline: Welcome to the future of booking
Home.body: Book local services or manage your calendar with Bookie. One platform for providers and the people who book them.

consumers.title: Find the right provider and book in minutes
consumers.subtitle: Everything you need to discover, book and keep track of appointments — with or without an account.

search.title: Search that forgives typos
search.body: Look up a provider or a service by name. Case, accents and spelling slips are forgiven, and suggestions appear as you type.

filters.title: Filter and sort
filters.body: Narrow results by category, to providers taking bookings now or open today, and sort by top rated, newest or name.

browse.title: Categories and organizations
browse.body: Browse by specialty, or open a clinic, salon or studio to see everyone who takes bookings there.

profiles.title: Know before you book
profiles.body: Provider pages show working hours, location, services with duration and price, accepted payment methods and reviews.

booking.title: Book in three steps
booking.body: Choose a service, a day and a time on one screen. Days with no open times are marked, so you never chase a full calendar.

guest.title: No account required
guest.body: Book with just your name, phone and email. Add notes for the provider and say how you would like to pay.

manage.title: Manage from one link
manage.body: Every booking gets its own link to view, cancel or reschedule it. Share it, copy the details or show a QR code.

emails.title: Email updates
emails.body: Get a confirmation when you book, an answer when a provider approves or declines your request, and a note when the time changes.

bookings.title: All your bookings in one place
bookings.body: Signed in, see every appointment, past and upcoming. Search, filter by status or service, and cancel what is still ahead.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.body: Tap the heart on any provider to save them, and find them again on your Favorites page.

reviews.title: Ratings and reviews
reviews.body: Rate your visit and help others choose. Edit or delete your review any time, and report one that breaks the rules.

access.title: Your language, any device
access.body: Use Bookie in 16 languages, sign in with Google or email, and install it on your phone like an app.

providers.title: Run your bookings from one workspace
providers.subtitle: A public page, your services and hours, and the tools to manage every appointment — all in one place.

profile.title: Your public page
profile.body: Photo, description, categories, address and contact details on a page clients can search for and book. Hide your phone number if you prefer.

visibility.title: Publish, pause or unlist
visibility.body: Pause new bookings without unlisting your page, or unpublish it and publish again whenever you are ready.

link.title: SEO and a custom link
link.body: Set the title and description search engines show. On a paid plan, choose a short custom link for your page too.

services.title: Service menu
services.body: Add services with a duration, price, currency, category and image. Deactivate one to hide it without deleting it.

hours.title: Working hours with breaks
hours.body: Set your hours for each day of the week, with up to five periods a day. Clients only see the times you are open.

approvals.title: Approve before it is booked
approvals.body: Turn on approvals to review each request first. The time is held while you decide, and the client is emailed either way.

bookings.title: Bookings calendar
bookings.body: See appointments by day on a month calendar and mark each one confirmed, completed, cancelled or missed. Bookings you make as a client get their own list.

alerts.title: Email alerts
alerts.body: Get an email when a booking is waiting for your approval or a client moves to a new time.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Bookings, revenue, completion and missed rates, busiest days and hours, top services and returning clients.

payments.title: Get paid your way
payments.body: List the in-person payment methods you accept, and optionally share an account number clients can copy.

reviews.title: Reply to reviews
reviews.body: Clients rate their visits, and a strong rating moves you up the provider list. Reply publicly to any review.

organizations.title: Part of an organization
organizations.body: List under your clinic, salon or studio — join an existing organization or add a new one when you sign up.
